# Benefits Review

Use with the [Benefits Review Process](../../docs/benefits/benefits-review-process.md) and [variance template](benefits-variance-analysis-template.md).

## When to use

At the approved midpoint, closure, 30/60/90-day checkpoints, or an event-driven review for a project with measurable benefit targets.

## When not to use

For emergent research outcomes without approved targets; use learning hypotheses until measurable benefits can be baselined.

## When to Use

Use at project closure, post-implementation review, or periodic benefit realization checkpoints when you need evidence-based assessment of actual vs. expected benefits. This template is most valuable when benefits are measurable and you have reliable baseline data for comparison.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for exploratory or research projects where benefits cannot yet be quantified; use learning hypotheses instead. Avoid this template as a substitute for ongoing benefit tracking during delivery—it is designed for periodic reviews, not continuous monitoring.
